messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Increased downstream error rate from tool-exec service. 5xxs and queue depth rising, p95 token latency > 2s across multiple regions. Auto-throttle attempted.
matt: seeing it. p95 and 5xx correlate with high fn/tool calls + large structured JSON responses. starting triage.
tara: logs show blowup from long-running external integrations and heavy JSON tool payloads. prefix cache miss rate up 4x.
vikram: impact - some enterprise tenants seeing 20-40% error rates on generation + slow streaming. support already fielding tickets. not a full outage but severe degradation.
lucy: FYI support channel, sending initial customer list (tenants A, C, gov-tenant). letting them know we're investigating.
matt: mitigation plan: 1) emergency rate cap on tool execution (global soft cap) 2) disable structured output mode and force plain-text streaming for all affected models 3) tighten per-tenant tool call quotas for free/burst tiers. will coordinate flags and rollout.
ops-jen: ready to flip flags. what endpoints?
matt: use admin feature-flag toggles, but we'll do curl for auditability. run this on control-plane (non-prod safeguards applied):
```
# emergency disable structured_output
curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://api.redwood-internal/v1/flags/structured_output -d '{"value":false}'

# soft-cap tool invocations to 5rps global
curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://api.redwood-internal/v1/rate-limits/tool-exec -d '{"global_rps":5}'
```
ops-jen: executing now, will push to canary then global. deploy-bot: canary rollout started (canary=10% traffic)
deploy-bot: canary healthy for 60s, metrics: tool-exec rps down 70%, p95 tokens improved ~30%.
tara: disabling structured outputs on model variants too — adding a runtime switch to strip tool-calls and JSON wrappers. patch applied to runtime (no restart) and propagated.
vikram: support: inform impacted customers that we've applied temporary limits and disabled advanced tool-driven features to restore latency. ETA ~15m to observe.
lucy: messaging drafted. sending to tenants A and C now. internal status page updated: "Degraded — mitigation in progress".
matt: handoff: tara (eng-sre) will lead monitoring for next 2 hours, vikram will coordinate customer comms, i'm stepping off after warm-handoff in 10m. leaving checklist:
- confirm global rps stays <= 5
- validate error rate falls to baseline
- confirm structured_output flag false in all regions
- note tenant-level exceptions (we may whitelist a couple enterprise customers after manual review)
- create postmortem ticket INC-2026-045

ops-jen: global flags applied. verification:
```
GET https://api.redwood-internal/v1/flags/structured_output -> false
GET https://api.redwood-internal/v1/rate-limits/tool-exec -> {"global_rps":5}
```
matt: :thumbsup: metrics look good in canary, rolling global. keep an eye on ingress/backpressure to downstream queues.
vikram: quick ask from product: can we restrict only free-tier and bursty API keys instead of global? if stable we can narrow scope after 10m.
tara: yes — once p95 < 1s and 5xx < baseline we will narrow to plan: global -> by-plan cap -> per-key caps -> then re-enable structured_output for verified keys.
lucy: customers responded: most OK with temporary limits, gov-tenant requested phone notify. arranging.
matt: handoff complete. tara leading oncall. i'll be reachable on DM. continuing watch.

--- 20m later ---

tara: p95 back to ~0.9s, 5xx down to baseline. tool-exec rps stable. starting staged rollback: move global_rps 5 -> per-plan 20 for enterprise -> 5 for freetier.
ops-jen: applied per-plan caps. structured_output still disabled; will enable for enterprise-only after validation.
vikram: product approves whitelist for 3 enterprise tenants to keep structured outputs enabled. will audit their recent usage patterns before full re-enable.
lucy: updated all customers: majority show improved performance, detailed followup to be sent in 24h.

matt: incident status -> mitigated. leaving notes for postmortem.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-045 created, severity=P2, owner=tara, start_ts=3065554321.
